site.title: BathyMap
site.description: Raw bathymetry survey data. Explore each survey line on the map, read the depth, date and time of individual soundings, and download the original files, CSV exports, or any area you select.
site.height_reference: GNSS heights above the ellipsoid, as logged (no geoid model applied). They are not heights above sea level and do not match the contours of the topographic basemap; the difference depends on the location.
